public_findings.title: Finalis testnet-1: BFT finality and confidential transactions from genesis
public_findings.snippet: Finalis testnet-1: BFT finality and confidential transactions from genesis Announcing the first public testnet of Finalis. Finalis is a UTXO blockchain where blocks are final once a quorum of the validator committee signs them. There are no reorgs and no waiting for confirmations: a transaction in a finalized block cannot be reversed. Amounts can be hidden. A confidential output carries a Pedersen commitment instead of a value, with a range proof that it is not negative. Validators check that inputs and outputs balance without learning the amounts. We propose a system in which every proof-of-work attempt must first execute a deterministic text-to-image model, so that block production consumes exactly the computation of generating images. The block header commits to the model output, and the seed of the model's initial noise is derived from the header itself, so changing the nonce requires running the model again and no attempt can be reused or precomputed. RandomX CPU Mining | Fair Launch | No Premine | No Presale | Bitcoin Core Based Back to the feeling of the beginning There was a time when mining did not belong to warehouses. No ASIC farms.
